text:
Anna L.: quick check — Datadog asked us to enter their certification track for the marketplace tile. who owns the telemetry contract and the OTEL test harness?
Sam R.: I can own the partner coordination, but need an eng owner for the tests. timeline?
Anna L.: DD gave a soft target: certification sign-off by 05/10 so we can sync with the press window. they also want a signed integration checklist + sample dashboards.
Jules (eng): I can take the tester side. main things: traces for request->model inference, inference latency metrics, GPU resource gauges, and span attributes for model.id + model.version.
Mike H.: for HW partners we also need nvml/GPU counters mapped into OTLP. can push a small collector extension that emits them as metrics. any preference for metric names?
Jules (eng): follow DD naming: redwood.inference.gpu.utilization, redwood.inference.batch.size, redwood.inference.kv_cache.hits. add trace attribute: rw.model.name and rw.model.rev.
Dawn P.: Marketing/Q needs the embargo window and approved demo script before announcement. Sam — can you confirm legal signoff cadence?
Sam R.: legal loop is 2 business days once integration docs are in. I'll ping legal now. @integrations-bot please create a checklist in the partner board.
integrations-bot: Created task RDW-4832: "Datadog certification — telemetry + dashboards" assigned to Jules (eng) and Mike H. Due: 2025-05-05.
Jules (eng): to unblock, pls share a staging Datadog account + API key. we’ll run the validation harness. also need sample trace payloads (1x cold, 1x warm flow).
Anna L.: staging creds request sent to DD via shared SSO. link to req: <https://okta.example/req/1234>
Mike H.: prototype OTEL collector config i ran locally — dropping it here so DD can reproduce:
```
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc:
processors:
  batch:
exporters:
  otlp/datadog:
    api_key: "<DATADOG_STAGING_KEY>"
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [batch]
      exporters: [otlp/datadog]
    metrics:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [batch]
      exporters: [otlp/datadog]
```
Jules (eng): small note — Datadog expects resource attributes for service.name and telemetry.sdk.name. add rw.instance_id as resource attr to correlate tiles.
Sam R.: copied. I'll share the config with the DD eng contact and ask for a brief smoke test slot this week.
Dawn P.: can we get a short blurb for the marketplace listing (1-2 lines) after certification? need to align with compliance language (no customer data retained).
Anna L.: agreed. sample blurb draft: "Redwood Inference — high-performance LLM serving with Datadog observability: traces, metrics, and dashboard templates for rapid monitoring." we can iterate.
Jules (eng): next steps for eng: 1) run harness against DD staging 2) confirm GPU metrics mapping 3) produce dashboard JSON export. I'll post results here.
Mike H.: I'll wire the nvml exporter into the collector and push a test container image to the partner registry by Friday.
Sam R.: scheduling follow-up sync: Friday 09:30 PT. I'll invite DD and HW SI lead.
Dawn P.: FYI — please keep the announcement embargoed until legal confirms. :lock:
Anna L.: thanks all — keeping this thread as the single source for telemetry cert updates. ping if blockers.
